'''Yamamoto Hachiman Shrine''' (山本八幡宮, Yamamoto Hachimangū) is a [[shrine]] located in {{ill|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|ar|فوجينوميا (شيزوكا)|arz|فوجينوميا، شيزوكا|azb|فوجی‌نومیا، شیزوئوکا|ce|Фудзиномия|ceb|Fujinomiya (lungsod sa Hapon)|cs|Fudžinomija|de|Fujinomiya|eo|Fuĝinomija|es|Fujinomiya|et|Fujinomiya|fa|فوجی‌نومیا، شیزوئوکا|fi|Fujinomiya|fr|Fujinomiya|hu|Fudzsinomija|hy|Ֆուձինոմիա|id|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|it|Fujinomiya|ja|富士宮市|ko|후지노미야시|lt|Fudžinomija|mg|Fujinomiya|mzn|فوجی‌نومیا، شیزوئوکا|nl|Fujinomiya|no|Fujinomiya|pl|Fujinomiya|pt|Fujinomiya|ro|Fujinomiya|ru|Фудзиномия|sh|Fujinomija|sr|Фуџиномија|sv|Fujinomiya|tg|Фуҷиномия|th|ฟูจิโนมิยะ|tl|Fujinomiya|tr|Fujinomiya|tt|Фудзиномия|uk|Фудзіномія|ur|فوجینومیا، شیزوکا|vi|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|war|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|zh|富士宮市|zh_classical|富士宮市|zh_min_nan|Huzinomiya-chhī|zh_yue|富士宮|qid=Q496072|lt=Fujinomiya}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|en|Shizuoka Prefecture|qid=Q131320|lt=Shizuoka Prefecture}}. It is also referred to as '''Tōdō Hachiman Shrine''' (多田八幡宮). Under the [[Modern shrine Ranking system]], it was classified as a Village Shrine.

== Origins ==
According to tradition, the shrine was established when Yoshino Sadatomi, the great-grandfather of {{ill|Yamamoto Kansuke (general)|en|Yamamoto_Kansuke_(general)|qid=Q468447|lt=Yamamoto Kansuke}}, enshrined the deity.
